jobs.title: Implementation Support Specialist - Special Projects
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated Implementation Support Specialist to join our team and act as a friendly, forward-facing resource for participants, caregivers, and care staff for our special projects, namely: THRIVE@Home. In this project, older adults aging in place will be using our Rendever VR platform to connect with residents of local senior living communities, helping to reduce social isolation and improve wellbeing. This project is kicking off in October 2026 and is supported by an incredible team, and we’re excited to add this role to help participants and their support networks navigate any potential challenges that arise as our platform is used in more diverse settings.

The Implementation Support Specialist is responsible for helping customers, participants, and caregivers troubleshoot issues with their Rendever system, coordinating the setup and scheduling of training calls, maintaining records of technical support interactions, and collaborating with others to improve the company's overall technical support capabilities. During the first six months, the Specialist will focus on shadowing our experienced VR Support Specialist and assisting with participant training, gradually transitioning to primarily supporting study participants and their care teams. Execution and an operational mindset are essential for success in this role.

If you’re unafraid to lean into the unknown and find solutions to technical user challenges, and you find excitement in learning about cutting-edge technology, you’ve come to the right place! Of course, we’re certain you’ll be a part of collecting some pretty incredible moments of impact each day, and can’t wait to see the stories come in.

Roles & responsibilities

* Support the setup and deployment of study systems, including tracking system deliveries and scheduling training calls.
* Act as the first point of contact for all inbound technical support requests from study participants, caregivers, and members of their care team.
* Navigate troubleshooting requests to resolution, and communicate solutions and next steps to both internal and participants in a clear, patient, and accessible manner.
* Write and deliver Bug Logs that clearly details steps to reproduce the bug, the overall impact on system usage, and assign severity level for the issue
* Work collaboratively with the Research, Community Engagement, and Product teams to ensure that all technical issues are resolved in a timely manner, and relevant feedback is shared and integrated into the product roadmap
* Manage communications with communities, participants, and families, ensuring we maintain the proactive and responsive delivery time that our brand is known for

  
**Requirements**

**Customer service:**

As Rendever’s first point of contact for technical support, your customer service skills will be used to put customers at ease and help them solve their technical problems

**Planning:**

Organizing tasks and coordinating schedules for system deliveries, training calls, and support requests ensures you can manage daily responsibilities from beginning to end.

**Communication skills:**

Excellent listening and verbal communication skills are required to understand concerns from participants, caregivers, and care staff and clearly explain technical solutions to people with varying levels of comfort and experience with technology.

**Technical Support Skills:**

Strong technical support skills are required in this role. Familiarity and interest in working with and helping others use computers and other technology remotely is vital to success. Having a passion of understanding new technology will help the Implementation Support Specialist succeed when working with participants who are using experimental technology, which will many times not have straightforward a previously documented solutions. troubleshoot VR hardware and software issues.

**Time management:**

You’ll use time management skills to prioritize technical support requests, training calls, and system set up priorities quickly, allowing you to address all department expectations.

**Problem-solving skills:**

Leveraging problem-solving skills to diagnose technical issues, guide participants, caregivers, and care staff through solutions, and escalate concerns when necessary. Problem solving skills are vital in this role, as you discover new technical issues for the first time, and work with the proper team to get them resolved, and the systems up and running again as soon as possible.

 **Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)

* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Short Term & Long Term Disability
* Work From Home
* Stock Option Plan

jobs.description:
**DIRECTOR OF PROGRAM IMPLEMENTATION**

**SUMMER SEARCH, NATIONAL (REMOTE)**

At Summer Search, we believe in 'No Ceilings' and envision a world in which young people, regardless of circumstances, can chart their own destiny. In the United States, students from underserved communities – disproportionately BIPOC and first-generation – face systemic inequities in school, in the workforce, and in life. Nevertheless, these young people possess unique strengths, resilience, and limitless potential.

Since 1990, Summer Search has partnered with young people during their transition from adolescence into adulthood by connecting them to expansive opportunities, professional mentoring, and a community of support. Summer Searchers recognize their potential and build a toolkit to navigate and challenge systemic barriers, break new ground for their families and communities, and achieve economic equity and a life of purpose.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Summer Search is seeking a Director of Program Implementation to join our National Program Team. This hire will provide strategic leadership to ensure we deliver consistent, and high-quality programming that is consistently evolving to youth across Summer Search’s entire network –which includes 3,000 participants this program year. Reporting to the Managing Director of Programs, the Director of Program Implementation will join a passionate and dedicated National Program Team who collaborates closely with our five regional sites across the network (Bay Area, Seattle, Philadelphia, NYC, and Boston), organizational leadership, and other national teams.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic program leader to make an impact on an organization on the National level across Summer Search’s core program components- High School Mentoring, Summer Experiences, and Post-Secondary Advising and Career Programming.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

The Director of Program Implementation is responsible for ensuring consistent, high-quality program delivery across the network by developing and strengthening implementation systems, operational processes, curriculum resources, training strategies, and support structures that drive positive outcomes for young people.

*Program implementation (50%):* *Lead national program implementation by ensuring fidelity to the organization’s model and building the systems, processes, and support structures needed for consistent program delivery and strong participant outcomes.*

* Oversee the review, enhancement, and implementation of curriculum and program resources to ensure relevance, feasibility, and effectiveness in meeting youth needs.
* Lead the ongoing evaluation and improvement of implementation tools, operational processes, and support mechanisms to increase efficiency, effectiveness, staff satisfaction, and program impact.
* Foster a culture of excellence, innovation, and data-informed decision-making that advances program quality, staff effectiveness, and outcomes for youth served by the organization.
* Support the implementation of new program initiatives, pilots, and organizational priorities, managing effective communication, and ensuring successful adoption across the network.

*Learning, Development, and Capacity Building (20%):* *Develop and coordinate carrying out strategies to address emerging site needs, ensuring sites receive timely, consistent, and high-quality support across the national network.*

* Ensure site program training, delivery, and outcomes are aligned with national standards.
* In partnership with the Talent team, design and lead strategies, that equip program staff with skills, tools and support they need to deliver high-quality programming with fidelity to our model including onboarding and ongoing training, coaching, and technical assistance.
* Establish and monitor program quality standards, implementation of benchmarks, and continuous improvement processes to drive strong and consistent outcomes.
* Provide National support for 2-3 cross-site program staff cohorts ensuring cohorts follow best practices and inform strategy and implementation org-wide.

*Program Leadership (30%) :* *Support National Program’s systems and structures and represent program as a key leader within the network.*

* Support the development and execution of long-term program strategy, crisis response protocol, annual program project plans, development of Program goals across the network, and budgeting processes in partnership with the Managing Director of Program.
* Drive the integration of equity, diversity, and inclusion (EDI) principles across all aspects of program design, delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement to advance equitable outcomes for young people.
* Identify opportunities to scale effective practices and strengthen operational systems in support of organizational growth and long-term sustainability.

**WHO YOU ARE**

The Director of Program implementation position calls for a motivated leader who can translate organization-wide strategies into local program delivery and who is passionate about program excellence. Specifically, this hire will bring:

* **EXPERIENCE:** A minimum of 7 years of experience in the non-profit sector inclusive of 4+ years of leadership in strategic implementation of programs and initiatives, preferably within human services, youth development, mentorship or education sectors. Experience working within a networked organization is a plus.
* **STRATEGIC ACUMEN:** You anticipate, articulate, and prepare for various outcomes and use this skill to collaboratively develop objectives and priorities that are informed by data and align with the organizational direction.
* **TEAMWORK AND COLLABORATION:** You value many voices, are comfortable creating space for dialogue and handle interpersonal issues constructively. You inspire and foster commitment, connection, enthusiasm and trust and motivate others to achieve common goals.
* **PROJECT MANAGEMENT:** You take initiative to create systems and structures to achieve goals and objectives. You succeed at managing multiple workstreams and motivating, coordinating, and directing others to stay on track.
* **ADAPTABILITY:** You tackle challenges and unfamiliar scenarios head-on with a solutions-oriented, flexible, and curious approach. You are willing to try new things and actively seek to understand multiple perspectives.
* **CRITICAL CONCIOUSNESS:** You have an understanding of the root causes of societal discrimination and injustices and are self-reflective about your own privilege and positional power. You apply critical thinking and take action toward liberatory and inclusive practices.
* **TECHNOLOGY SKILLS:** (if applicable) Command of CRM for program data management and reporting, Salesforce strongly preferred. Ability to use data systems to inform decision making.

In addition, all Summer Search staff bring a commitment to our mission of unleashing students’ potential through mentoring and transformative experiences, as well as the ability to thrive in an environment that values excellence, gratitude, well-being, diversity, authenticity, and collaboration.

**LOCATION AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS**

New hires must be residing in one of their following states by their first day of employment: California, Washington, Pennsylvania, New York, or Massachusetts.

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

Competitive and transparent salaries. This is an exempt position with an annual salary ranging from $112,705 - $121,295. Summer Search is committed to transparent, equitable compensation practices. Salaries are benchmarked using current market data and salary bands are created to demonstrate the growth potential within the band. Typically, offers are made at the starting place of the salary band. The Hiring Manager partners with the Talent Team to ensure offers are appropriate, competitive and maintain internal equity.

Well-being, flexibility, and ongoing learning and development are pillars of our culture. We value our staff and are committed to creating an environment where every individual feels seen, heard and valued. Investments in our staff include:

* Medical insurance with up to 90% employer contribution
* Dental, vision, FSA, life and disability insurance plans
* 401 (K) and Employer Match up to $2,000 annually
* Generous time off including 15 vacation days, 10 sick days, and 18 holidays (2 floating holidays of your choice, a birthday day-off, 10 company-wide holidays, and a 1-week December closure).
* Refresh Friday’s – a paid day off the first Friday of every month!
* A comprehensive Employee Recognition Program (years of service awards, spot awards, and professional development funding).
* A four-week paid sabbatical after five years of continuous employment.
* Individual, local, regional and national training.
* A commitment to developing leaders from within the organization.
* An organizational culture that supports staff well-being and holistic self-care/community care.
* Ample opportunities to connect with the students and communities we serve.

**OUR COMMITMENT TO EQUITY, DIVERSITY, AND INCLUSION**

With a staff that cares deeply about social justice and racial justice, we believe that diverse perspectives and backgrounds create a rich work environment and enhance our ability to pursue our mission. We are committed to building an organization with critical consciousness in order to impact how we work with students, as well as how we work together as a team. We hope you will join us as we continue to build a justice-centered organization that fosters a work environment where people from all backgrounds are welcomed and valued.  
  
**TO APPLY**

Select "Apply for this Position" below to submit a resume and targeted cover letter, addressed to Wanda Montañez, Managing Director of Program, that answers the question, “Why are you interested in the Director of Implementation opportunity at Summer Search?”

*SUMMER SEARCH IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.*

Uplinq is the AI-powered bookkeeping and tax automation platform built for small business owners. We’re re-engineering how entrepreneurs manage their finances, replacing manual bookkeeping, rules, and spreadsheets with intelligent automation that delivers real-time clarity and control.

We’re a Series A startup backed by top investors, growing fast. Our team is lean, execution-focused, and allergic to fluff. We measure success in demos booked, pipelines created, and revenue influenced.

**Individual applicants residing in the US only**  
  
**About the role**

As a Senior Onboarding Accounting Specialist, you'll be the first point of contact for new Uplinq clients — guiding them through system setup, data clean-up, and account activation.

This is a high-touch, high-volume role: you'll juggle a large, active portfolio of clients at different onboarding stages, which means the job rewards people who communicate early and often, adapt quickly when something isn't working, and hold themselves accountable for outcomes rather than just effort.

The right candidate will have a magnetic presence on calls and an excitement about interaction with small business owners. The ideal candidate is a person the clients look forward to speaking with, someone who makes them feel confident in the investment they’ve made when choosing Uplinq.

**What you'll do**

* Lead daily client meetings to gather financial data, clarify scope, and build trust from the first call — earning it through rapport, clarity, and follow-through, not just technical accuracy.
* Set up and configure Uplinq and QuickBooks Online accounts, including resolving integration and access issues (Plaid connections, payroll, revenue processors, inventory systems, etc) so systems sync cleanly from day one.

* 6+ years of daily QuickBooks use including Online setup, integrations, and troubleshooting (not desktop).
* Strong working knowledge of both cash- and accrual-based accounting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage 25+ active client relationships at once without letting communication or follow-through slip — someone who escalates early, adapts on the fly, and takes ownership of outcomes rather than absorbing pressure silently.
* A warm, confident, and memorable presence with clients — someone who builds real rapport fast, puts anxious business owners at ease, and makes a technical process feel personal rather than transactional.
* Comfortable having direct conversations with clients about scope and pricing when what they signed doesn't match what they need, and willing to admit and correct course quickly when something's off.

We serve employers, members, and providers through a value-based care network, a risk contracting engine, and a real-time data and analytics platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where every person owns outcomes, not just tasks.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

The Implementation Lead owns the end-to-end onboarding of new employer groups and TPA partners, from signed agreement through effective date and a stable first 60 days. You are the single point of accountability for a clean, on-time go-live: the plan is built correctly, eligibility flows, ID cards and welcome kits land, the member app is configured, and the client knows exactly where things stand at every step.

This is a hands-on, build-the-playbook role. You will run implementations yourself while standardizing how XO does them, so that each one is faster and cleaner than the last. You will work across Commercial, Plan Operations, Claims, Network, IT, and Compliance, and you will be the person clients, brokers, and TPAs trust to get them live.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Client and TPA Onboarding:**

* Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new employer groups and TPA partners, from kickoff through effective date and post-go-live stabilization.
* Build and maintain the implementation plan for each client: benefit design and plan documents, group structure, eligibility and enrollment setup, stop-loss coordination, vendor and partner integrations, member communications, and compliance requirements.
* Own the accurate setup of each group across XO's systems and partner platforms, including benefit configuration, eligibility file testing, ID card and welcome kit production, member app configuration, and any SSO or portal integrations.
* Translate client-specific requirements into clear instructions for internal teams and confirm they are executed correctly before go-live.

**Project Management:**

* Run the cross-functional implementation team and ensure critical milestones are completed. Surface risks early, resolve blockers, and escalate with a recommendation when needed.
* Coordinate with Claims, Plan Operations, Network, IT, Compliance, and Finance to ensure ownership is properly assigned and dates are adhered to .
* Maintain a regular reporting cadence with leadership and flag anything that puts a go-live at risk.

**Client Communication:**

* Serve as the primary contact for the client, broker, and TPA throughout implementation. Lead recurring status meetings and keep a clear record of open items and decisions.
* Prepare client-facing implementation documentation, checklists, and readiness sign-offs.
* Hand off cleanly to the ongoing account owner at the end of the stabilization period, with full documentation of the group's setup and any open items.

**Playbook and Continuous Improvement:**

* Own XO's implementation playbook: standard timelines, checklists, templates, and data requirements for employer and TPA onboarding.
* Identify manual steps and failure points in the process and work with Operations and Product to automate or remove them.
* Turn lessons from each implementation into playbook improvements that strengthen the process and enable scale ahead of growth.

**EXPERIENCE and EDUCATION:**

**Required:**

* 5+ years in implementation, client onboarding, or project management within self-funded health benefits, TPA operations, or a health plan.
* Working knowledge of self-funded medical and pharmacy plan design, and the compliance landscape that comes with it (ERISA, ACA, CAA, Mental Health Parity).
* Direct experience running complex, multi-party healthcare implementations on a fixed effective date.
* Fluency in the employer and TPA distribution channel, including how brokers, consultants, benefits administrators, and stop-loss carriers fit together.
* Comfort with eligibility files, enrollment data, and system configuration. You do not need to be technical, but you need to be precise and unafraid of the details.
* Clear, concise communicator who can confidently lead client discussions and provide leadership with direct, well-informed answers.
* Strong organizational skills and the judgment to prioritize when everything feels urgent.

**Preferred**:

* Experience implementing on behalf of, or alongside, a TPA.
* Experience at an early-stage or high-growth company where you built the process rather than inherited it.
* Familiarity with health plan technology platforms, member apps, or provider directory tools.
* PMP or similar project management credentials.

**KEY PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES:**

***Accountability:*** you own the outcome and say so when something is off track.

***Critical Thinking:*** you solve problems from first principles and learn what the organization needs next.

***Change Champion:*** you are committed to building and comfortable when the plan changes.

***Relationships:***you build trust quickly with clients, partners, and colleagues.

Description:

The Sr. Director of Product, EHR/eMAR will own product strategy and execution for Residex’s EHR and eMAR capabilities across the senior living and hospice continuum, ensuring clinical documentation, medication administration, and compliance workflows meet the rigorous demands of senior living, skilled nursing, and hospice care. This role provides first-level supervision of the product and software engineers aligned to EHR/eMAR, and partners closely with the General Manager of the Thea EHR/eMAR line of business across product, business, and operational priorities.

Responsibilities include:

* Serve as right hand and back-up to the General Manager of the Thea EHR/eMAR line of business—partnering on strategic priorities, business performance, and operational decisions, representing the GM’s priorities across Product, Engineering, and go-to-market teams, and leading and positively influencing the broad team to achieve OKRs, including Profit & Loss (P&L), Sales, Brand, and Customer Loyalty.
* Own the Thea® vision, the AI roadmap, and execution for Residex’s EHR and eMAR capabilities—from clinical documentation and care planning to medication administration, physician orders, and survey-ready compliance records.
* Supervise Product Managers and Business Analysts aligned to the EHR/eMAR portfolio—setting development plans, conducting performance reviews, and ensuring adherence to company and departmental policies, procedures, and product standards.
* Translate deep domain expertise in senior living, assisted living, skilled nursing, and hospice care into product requirements—including EHR/eMAR workflows, PRN and controlled-substance documentation, physician order management, and interdisciplinary team (IDT) care planning for hospice.
* Own compliance-by-design for EHR/eMAR: ensure the platform produces defensible, survey-ready documentation that satisfies state licensing surveys and CMS Conditions of Participation, and—for hospice—Medicare Hospice Benefit documentation requirements (certifications of terminal illness, face-to-face encounters, plans of care).
* Partner with Engineering on EHR/eMAR architecture and interoperability—HL7/FHIR data exchange, pharmacy and lab integrations—and the clinical data model underlying THEA’s clinical guardrails and recommendations.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to position EHR/eMAR capabilities competitively, support customer-facing demos and discovery, and ensure go-to-market materials reflect current clinical and regulatory depth.
* Engage directly with clinicians, caregivers, hospice IDT members, and facility administrators through discovery interviews and validation sessions to keep EHR/eMAR decisions grounded in real clinical and operational workflows.
* Establish product metrics and KPIs for EHR/eMAR adoption, documentation completion, and medication administration accuracy; iterate based on usage data and customer feedback.

Requirements:

Minimum requirements:

* 15+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years in a senior leadership capacity at B2B SaaS companies—healthcare, senior living, or hospice strongly preferred.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with EHR and eMAR systems in senior living, skilled nursing, assisted living, or hospice settings, including medication administration workflows, physician orders, and clinical documentation.
* Working knowledge of the state and federal regulatory frameworks governing senior living and hospice documentation.
* Proven ability to translate clinical and regulatory requirements into product requirements, data models, and configurable workflows.
* Strong technical acumen, with experience collaborating with engineering teams on complex, integrated clinical platforms.
* Track record managing product managers and/or business analysts, with experience building clear product ownership models.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to represent clinical and product depth to customers, clinicians, and executive stakeholders.
* Data-driven mindset, with experience using analytics to inform product decisions and measure documentation quality, adoption, and clinical outcomes.

**Job Title:** EHR Analyst, Senior

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
The EHR Application Analyst Senior serves as an advanced-level contributor in the support, optimization, and ongoing development of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role handles complex technical issues, leads system optimization efforts, and serves as a resource and mentor for junior analysts. The EHR Application Analyst Senior applies deep knowledge of EHR capabilities and healthcare business workflows to drive improvements that enhance clinical and operational performance.  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Advanced System Support and Maintenance:
* Serve as a primary escalation point for complex technical issues and system errors, applying advanced troubleshooting techniques to ensure timely resolution and minimal disruption to patient care.
* Provide day-to-day technical support to end-users, including troubleshooting issues, answering questions, and resolving system errors to ensure uninterrupted use of the EHR system.
* Provide guidance to junior analysts on day-to-day support challenges, sharing expertise and building team capability.
* Lead and coordinate routine maintenance activities, including software updates, patches, and upgrades, to ensure the stability and security of the EHR system.
* Coordinate testing and validation activities for system changes, enhancements, and upgrades, ensuring new features meet functional requirements without introducing unintended disruptions.
* Participate in on-call rotations, including taking lead responsibility for after-hours coverage on complex or escalated issues.

System Optimization:

* Lead efforts to optimize the performance, usability, and efficiency of the EHR system.
* Conduct workflow assessments with operational partners to identify build inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and advance optimization requests through appropriate governance and change management channels.
* Apply cross-application integration knowledge to identify dependencies and ensure cohesive system performance across modules.

Collaboration and Vendor Engagement:

* Take ownership of defined work streams or components within EHR implementation projects, system upgrades, and other initiatives.
* Coordinate task assignments, track progress, and communicate status to project leads, ensuring deliverables are completed on time and within scope.
* Own ongoing relationships with EHR vendor support, including managing open support requests, evaluating release notes for operational impact, and representing the organization in user group sessions and advisory forums.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams - including IT, clinicians, administrators, and vendors - to support EHR initiatives and facilitate effective communication across stakeholder groups.

Documentation and Knowledge Management:

* Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, processes, and procedures.
* Establish knowledge-sharing practices to ensure critical information is accessible and current across the team.

Training and Mentorship:

* Provide training and mentorship to junior analysts and end-users, sharing best practices to enhance team capabilities and support continuous professional development.

Compliance and Data Privacy

* Handle all protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations and organizational data privacy and security policies.
* Complete required compliance training and model information security best practices for the team.

* Excellent analytical, organization, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and within teams.
* Ability to solve complex problems and understand translate customer needs into system solutions.
* Strong understanding of healthcare business process, workflows, and terminology.
* Cross-application integration knowledge.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity tools.
* Degree in Computer Science, healthcare or related field.

* Minimum two (2) to five (5) years of experience as an EHR Application Analyst, Health IT Analyst, Epic Analyst, or in a related healthcare information systems role.
